title: Partner service categories
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2025-10-30
html:
Service categories are predefined groupings that help organize and categorize the various services offered by partners on TikTok Shop Partner Center. These categories make it easier for TikTok Shop sellers to find relevant services that align with their needs and goals. Partners can select the appropriate service category when creating a service to ensure it's listed in the relevant section of the App & Service Store, making it more discoverable to potential clients. 📌 The service categories available to a partner are determined by several factors, including the partner's registration region and their chosen target market. This means that partners will only see service categories that are relevant to their region and target market when creating services on TikTok Shop Partner Center. This helps ensure that partners can offer services that are appropriate for their specific business context and geographic focus.

Shop Management
Store operation services for sellers include store setup and decoration, product management and listing, marketing promotion planning, and customer service, aiming to boost store traffic, sales, and brand influence.
LIVE Management
TSP provides self-LIVE services for sellers covering live streaming planning, content creation, equipment setup, host training, real-time operation, and data analysis. The goal is to enhance exposure, attract traffic, boost conversion rates, and maximize sales through sellers’ self-live streams.
Short Video Management
Short-video services for sellers include content planning, video shooting, editing, optimization, and distribution. Services also involve optimizing titles, tags, and descriptions to boost search rankings and exposure, helping sellers target users precisely for enhanced followings, retention, and conversions.
Seller affiliate Management
Primarily seller-focused, this involves: helping sellers select optimal products, set competitive commissions, and list them in open commission markets or launch seller-initiated campaigns to invite creators to promote products.
